name: My - eto glavnoe
source: You probably also thought about what a romantic relationship between Ulyana and Semyon would look like. This mod was created to present a scenario in which this pairing is possible. The author's sick imagination, many new CGs and music, and “atypical” character development are included.
translation: 你可能也想过乌里安娜和谢苗之间的浪漫关系会是什么样子。创建这个模组是为了呈现一个可以进行这种配对的场景。包括作者病态的想象力、许多新的CG和音乐以及“非典型”的角色发展。
